data.title: Adobe Earns Buy Rating as Management Lifts Revenue and EPS Guidance on Strengthening AI-Driven ARR
data.description:
D.A. Davidson analyst Gil Luria has maintained their bullish stance on ADBE stock, giving a Buy rating today.

Gil Luria has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors that highlight Adobe’s durability and growth prospects. He notes that the company delivered double‑digit revenue and subscription growth despite broader software sector concerns, and is rapidly expanding AI‑driven recurring revenue, with Firefly and other AI offerings contributing meaningfully to total ARR.

Luria also points to Adobe’s strong profitability profile and improved guidance as key supports for the Buy rating. Management raised both quarterly and full‑year revenue and EPS targets, while maintaining robust operating margins and projecting a seasonally stronger ARR build in the coming quarter, which together reinforce confidence in Adobe’s long‑term value creation potential.
